data.content_ref: inline:Strengthen the grounded extension by making validity-node closure an intrinsic derived property of the fixpoint rather than an enforcement in att construction: add a monotone closure operator that, at each pass, treats any attacker of a validity_node as attacking the warrant carrier, so the closure is re-derived by the same skeptical rule. Determinism and polynomial cost are preserved because the operator is monotone and idempotent, and validity of committed roots becomes a theorem of the fixpoint itself.
